PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_5 Multi-Project Workspace
PHASE.GOAL: Add Synapse.toml workspace orchestration for verifying, indexing, listing, and summarizing multiple member projects.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Synapse.toml defines workspace members, excludes, and defaults for profile, parallel execution, and fail-fast behavior.
syn workspace verify loads the workspace, validates members, runs per-member verification, and returns an aggregate report.
syn workspace index, status, and coverage reuse existing single-project engines from each member root.

STEPS.step-1: Implement workspace config model, load/init validation, member resolution, excludes, and default policy.
STEPS.step-2: Implement sequential and parallel member execution with fail-fast semantics and compact reports.
STEPS.step-3: Add syn workspace init, list, verify, status, index, and coverage command surface.
STEPS.step-4: Prepare coverage aggregation for workspace members and later code coverage integration.
STEPS.step-5: Add workspace CLI tests with passing and failing member fixtures.

VERIFICATION.CHECK: syn workspace init proj-a proj-b creates Synapse.toml.
syn workspace list shows resolved members.
syn workspace verify supports default parallel mode and --sequential mode.
syn workspace status returns aggregate health without reading unrelated directories.

RISKS.RISK: Parallel verification can overload local machines; keep --sequential and fail-fast defaults explicit.
Workspace roots may not all be MyGRACE projects; report per-member errors without hiding successful members.
